Why the Academy

Training that turns floor staff into confident product specialists

Every course is written for the showroom floor: what the customer is asking, what the product actually does, and how to recommend the right model the first time.

Product education

Accurate, manufacturer-sourced product knowledge — models, positioning systems, sizing, fabrics and options — in short, visual lessons.

Sales confidence

Real customer scenarios and a proven consultation method, so new and experienced staff ask better questions and close with confidence.

Self-paced learning

Lessons work on a phone, tablet or desktop and save progress automatically, so staff can learn between appointments.

Certification

A timed final exam and an HCPS-issued certificate your team can verify online — proof of knowledge for your customers and managers.

Employee development

A clear path for onboarding new hires and keeping experienced staff current as product lines change.

How it works

From invitation to certificate in five steps

  1. Access the Academy

    Sign in with a one-time email code, or open Training from the 360 Dealer Portal.

  2. Enroll employees

    Your Training Manager — or HCPS — invites staff and enrolls them in a course.

  3. Complete training

    Short, visual lessons with practice checks, on any device. Progress saves automatically.

  4. Pass the assessment

    A timed final exam drawn from every module. 80% earns the certification.

  5. Earn the certificate

    An HCPS-issued certificate with a number anyone can verify online, valid for 12 months.
